card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit token in the middle or end of a multi-digit number, such as counts, fractions like (19/24), or measurements. It is most active in the second or third digit position, often right after a comma or slash.

modes.label: Counts in fractions
modes.description: A digit inside the numerator or denominator of patient counts or percentages.
modes.example: Hyperthyroidism resolved in 79% (19/<<2>>4) of these patients.

modes.label: Numbers with thousands or decimals
modes.description: A digit following a comma or within a long number such as populations, areas or trial group sizes.
modes.example: The population density was 1,<<0>>61.1 people per square mile

card.writes: It promotes digit tokens, so it helps the model continue a number with another digit.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number and helps predict the next digit.
